request.prompt:
Goods: Electric guitar
Country of origin: ID

Chosen so far: 92 Musical instruments; parts and accessories of such articles

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 9209: Musical instrument parts (for example, mechanisms for musical boxes) and accessories (for example, cards, discs and rolls for mechanical instruments); metronomes, tuning forks and pitch pipes
    contains 920994: Musical instruments; parts and accessories for the musical instruments the sound of which is produced or must be amplified electrically (e.g. organs, guitars and accordions)
    contains 920930: Musical instrument strings
- 9207: Musical instruments; the sound of which is produced or must be amplified, electrically (e.g. organs, guitars, accordions)
    contains 920790: Musical instruments; (other than keyboard), the sound of which is produced or must be amplified electrically
    contains 920710: Musical instruments; keyboard, (other than accordions), the sound of which is produced or must be amplified electrically
- 9202: Musical instruments; string, n.e.c. in heading no. 9201, (e.g. guitars, violins, harps)
    contains 920290: Musical instruments; string, played other than with a bow (e.g. guitars and harps)
    contains 920210: Musical instruments; string, played with a bow (e.g. violins)

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: An electric guitar is a musical instrument whose sound is produced or must be amplified electrically, which heading 9207 names expressly (e.g. guitars), so it takes precedence over the string-instrument heading 9202.
